articles.title: Makita (TSE:6586) Stock Stalls As Q2 Earnings Strength Builds
articles.summary: Makita stock closed at ¥5,264 on 30 October, roughly flat over the past month, as investors digested fresh Q2 2027 earnings. The headline is simple: profitability kept climbing while the share price barely moved. The power tool maker delivered Basic EPS of ¥97.23 on quarterly revenue of ¥208,163 million, reinforcing a trailing P/E of 15.3x that currently sits below peer averages. articles.summary: Makita has delivered a 58.6% share price gain over the past three years, which puts fresh focus on whether that climb is grounded in the cash the business can generate. With the stock now trading at ¥5,226, the question is how well that market tag lines up with an intrinsic value estimate built from its cash flows.
